title: formattng / layout of a response like this can be improved [image 1]
summary: The fix belongs in the renderer: a short update written before a tool call gets glued onto the next text block with no space. Finding where that happens.I fixed it: when a reply has text before and after tool calls, the pieces are now saved with a blank line between them instead of being joined into one paragraph. The agent tests (486) and app tests (419) pass, and new tests cover this case.
